method: Same synthetic input/seed/profile, counterbalanced variant order and two original/additional rounds; historical localContrast unchanged. Aligned observer runs after timed export on all builds; PR7 shipping aligned QA is included in export time.
limits: Shared host CPU scheduling is uncontrolled; no exclusive reservation
Two per-case original/additional trials do not establish per-case P95 confidence
Synthetic fixtures and short ranges do not establish full-song artistic quality
Peak process/GPU memory, cache-hit ratio and native save picker are UNMEASURED

pairedOriginalReadability.population: Original 24 only, finite in both engines, per-input medians over two rounds; repeats excluded. Pooled original+repeat medians 84/94 are a different population.
